segments.text: A girl coming to ward 13 to work as a teacher after receiving her teaching license. Besides giving normal lessons, she sets out another goal to fulfill all of her four students' wishes before school closure in 4 months.

It was not after Sakai-san's death did her casual school life undergo a drastic change. Many things get unveiled, questions left unanswered, till this day. The reason behind her amnesia, the 2014 incident, and above all, Mirai's wish of searching for a certain "book"... An adventure begins, as she decided to pursue the answers to everything.

Despite being hard-headed sometimes, the protagonist is a caring, emotional girl. She loves drinking strawberry milk and listening to radio with Mirai in her meantime. In the school, she would play catch with her students after class is over.
Later on, her name is revealed to be
Inamori Alice

A student of the class. However, different from her other classmates, she usually skips it, goes up the hill and gazes aimlessly for hours instead. Upon hearing that Alice is going to fulfill her wish, she decides to come back with her, to her hometown.

For the cult member, Mirai is well-known as the "God's child" for her infamous "Vanished Mountain" incident. Her power, "silent explosion", has such immense power that the Japanese government has decided to let her do whatever she pleased. After running away from the mountain, she restarts her life by coming to ward 13.
Despite being somewhat strange in the first place, Mirai is very kind toward her younger classmates. Regarding her emotionlessness,
it is crucial in keeping her power stable, under control.
A student of the class. She is a cheerful girl, sometimes she gets flustered by taking other people's joke too seriously. Her parents have a small coffee shop outside of ward 13.
Being an obedient child, she never speaks her mind in front of them, not even her wish of
"moving out together with everyone". It's because of her parents' duty to take care of a tree in the town's shrine, which is said to protect this town.

She is a childhood friend of Takeshi, and is on good terms with Mirai as well. The three of them used to play catch together before Alice comes to town. Despite her cheerful appearance, she can be very serious and mature occasionally.

A student of the class. Takeshi has a burning passion toward baseball, as he would spend hours practicing pitching after school. His wish is to participate in a baseball match before school closure. He always cheers everyone up by his bright smile and carefree spirit, this becomes more evident when times get tough.
Asuna's childhood friend. Takeshi's father owns a grocery shop in ward 13, and it is said that his personality resembles his father a lot. Loves eating curry and hotpot.
Youngest member of the class. Haruto is a friendly person, as he gets along very well with his classmates. However,

as the story progresses, another side of Haruto is revealed the moment he witnessed a homicide up the hill. Shocked by the sudden happenings, he gradually turns silent, keeping distance from everyone. Fortunately, Alice managed to clear things out afterward, and Haruto gradually comes back to his former self.
Haruto also likes baseball, albeit not as good as Takeshi. His parents run a beauty salon inside ward 13. As the only son in the family, he wants his parents to be more intimate with each other.
Subaru is a resident of ward 25. Haruka's younger brother. Following Master's recommendation, Alice goes seek his advice regarding her trip
to the "Vanished Mountain" area.

Tired of the social lifestyle, Subaru chooses to reside underground, where he would spend all days working and playing games on his computer. One could refer to him as a hikikomori, despite that, Subaru is a very knowledgeable person, thanks to all his friends and connections made online. He is also the creator of the Telepathy Network (TPN). Has a firm belief that everything must be traded equally, and is willing to help anyone he deems "qualified", with all his might.
A special robot. If under operation, all superpower couldn't be used in a certain radius from it.

The principal of the school Alice's currently teaching. After a discussion with Alice's sister, they have come to a mutual conclusion, which is to let Alice come to ward 13 and start working from 1 Dec 2026.
A responsible person with a signature gentle smile, the principal is hardly agitated by anything. However,
beyond it lies numerous secrets being kept hidden from everyone else. Alice's father's death, or reasons behind her amnesia, ... things only start to emerge after the second murder case in town.
The principal stays inside the school,
together with Alice and Mirai
. Likes reading and is pretty decent at cooking. He has a "neutral" personality, maintaining his objective judgment towards everything.
Asuna's father.
A wise and knowledgeable person, especially about
"infected person"
. Adhering to his belief, Master could be very stubborn sometimes. He, his wife, and Takeshi's father are classmates since childhood.
Asuna's mother,
Subaru's older sister.

Her background is revealed in the latter part of the story. The Shishime family has the duty to protect this town, by protecting the tree inside the town's shrine. Being the youngest of all sisters, she must remain in ward 13 forever to carry on with her duty.
Despite being with Asuna all the time, she
has never seen Asuna's true feelings
. Upon hearing from Alice regarding Asuna's wish, Haruka decided to support her.
Alice's biological mother.
Takeshi's father.

Super Yamazaki is an energetic, cheerful person, albeit perceived as immature by others sometimes. He owns a small grocery shop in town. Has always wanted his son to become the greatest hero in history, that's why he named him "Takeshi", with "Take (武)" being "bravery", and "shi (史)" being "history".
Owner of Miira shop, a mysterious shop that "sells everything" in ward 13.
Later in the story, it's revealed that Miira is the only survivor of the "Vanished Mountain" incident caused by Mirai's power, suffered from only an enormous burn on his side.
His name "Miira", which means mummy,
originates from Mirai
, after seeing him fully covered with bandages.

Adopted and raised by the Shirakawa family from his childhood, Ryouhei has been involved in the family's business ever since. He is also the person-in-charge of the inheritance battle among the Shirakawa sisters, following Kimikage's order.

Alice's second personality. Acting as a defensive mechanism, Kimikage would temporarily "replace" her in order to protect her mental state, on a trigger. In this story, the trigger is whenever Alice sees blood. To successfully do so, Kimikage is willing to take any measures, no matter the cost.
Not to be mistaken with Shirakawa Kimikage - Alice's biological father.
Isurugi Yuu is a politician associated with the ward dividing plan to protect residents from "infected people". He used to be Eku's student.
Protagonist's sister. She is also the eldest among 18 sisters of the Shirakawa family. Used to be a teacher, however, she quits her job after the calamity in 2014.
Kagesa is the second oldest among 18 sisters of the Shirakawa family.
She has always
had a deep hatred towards Eku since the day Eku ran away, leaving her alone to deal with all hardship in the family.
A mysterious woman that Alice encounters in the public bathhouse.
She seems to be quite knowledgeable regarding Alice's current condition.
